extension.summary: Show what Kodi is playing on an AX206 or Samsung SPF USB display
Zeigt die Kodi-Wiedergabe auf einem AX206- oder Samsung-SPF-USB-Display an
extension.description:
Drives two families of USB display: the 3.5" 480x320 panels built around the AX206 controller - sold as AIDA64 / SmartDisplay screens and known from the dpf-ax and lcd4linux projects - and the Samsung SPF photo frames (SPF-72H, SPF-87H, SPF-107H and relatives) in their "mini monitor" mode.
The service shows what Kodi is playing: title, artist, album, cover art, a progress bar with elapsed and remaining time, plus clock, system load, temperature and anything else Kodi knows. Everything on screen is described by a JSON layout file, so pages, fonts, colours, positions and the data behind them can be changed freely. Any Kodi InfoLabel can be placed on the display.
No extra Python modules are needed: USB access uses libusb through ctypes, and the PNG/JPEG decoders and font renderer are part of the add-on.

Steuert zwei Familien von USB-Displays an: die 3,5" 480x320 LCDs mit AX206-Controller - als AIDA64-/SmartDisplay-Bildschirme verkauft und aus den Projekten dpf-ax und lcd4linux bekannt - sowie die Samsung-SPF-Bilderrahmen (SPF-72H, SPF-87H, SPF-107H und Verwandte) in deren "Mini-Monitor"-Modus.
Der Dienst zeigt die laufende Wiedergabe: Titel, Interpret, Album, Cover, einen Fortschrittsbalken mit gespielter und verbleibender Zeit, dazu Uhr, Systemauslastung, Temperatur und alles weitere, was Kodi kennt. Der gesamte Bildschirminhalt wird über JSON-Layoutdateien beschrieben, sodass Seiten, Schriften, Farben, Positionen und Datenquellen frei angepasst werden können. Jedes Kodi-InfoLabel lässt sich anzeigen.
Zusätzliche Python-Module werden nicht benötigt: Der USB-Zugriff läuft über libusb via ctypes, PNG-/JPEG-Dekoder und Schriftrenderer sind Teil des Add-ons.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an AX206 based USB display with the dpf-ax firmware (USB ID 1908:0102) or a Samsung SPF photo frame.
Benötigt ein AX206-basiertes USB-Display mit dpf-ax-Firmware (USB-ID 1908:0102) oder einen Samsung-SPF-Bilderrahmen.
extension.news:
v1.6.0 - Layouts are picked from a list of preview pictures, and the settings stay open while choosing
v1.5.1 - Samsung model picked from a list of the known frames, AX206-only settings hidden while a Samsung frame is selected
v1.5.0 - The display now follows Kodi's language, layouts can use $LOCALIZE[id]
v1.4.0 - Dims while nothing is playing, brightness for Samsung frames, AX206 brightness fix
v1.3.1 - Overview images of every bundled layout, and the tool that generates them
v1.3.0 - Eight more layouts: light, terminal, neon, vinyl, nextup, weather, library and a portrait layout for a rotated display, each in both display sizes - A wide flat line widget now draws a horizontal rule of that height
v1.2.0 - Five layouts built for reading from a distance (xl-player, xl-remaining, xl-clock, xl-system, cover-full), in both display sizes - Larger bundled fonts, a layout rescaling tool, and fixes for the reported IP address and free disk space
v1.1.1 - Start/stop shell commands, so a smart plug can power a Samsung frame with the box
v1.1.0 - Support for Samsung SPF photo frames (SPF-72H and relatives, 800x480 and larger) including the switch out of mass storage mode - Built-in JPEG encoder that re-encodes only the MCU rows that changed - Layouts for 800x480 panels, picked automatically by display size
v1.0.1 - Fixed the service failing to start on CoreELEC: text files are now read as UTF-8 instead of the C locale's ASCII - Fixed the configured USB device IDs not reaching the driver, which made the add-on report "no AX206 display found" even with a panel attached - Fixed the "User layout folder" setting being rejected by Kodi when left empty
v1.0.0 - First release - AX206 USB LCD support with partial screen updates - JSON layout engine with pages, conditions and Kodi InfoLabel access - Bundled layouts: Default, Big Cover, Minimal, Dashboard - Built-in PNG/JPEG decoding and anti-aliased bitmap fonts
